steps.text: Hey, I finally have time to eat without someone asking me about our group project 😮‍💨
Did you escape?
Temporarily
I said I needed lunch and someone asked if we could discuss the slides while I ate
Did you throw the slides at them?
I considered it
But I found a table outside instead, so I'm choosing personal growth
Proud of you
Thank you 😌
Here's my very exclusive lunch spot
You found somewhere sunny
Yes, and my lunch hasn't asked a single question about the presentation
Excellent company
You're invited next time. Provided you bring your own fries
I've been thinking about yesterday
Mostly about what I'd actually feel comfortable doing first
And did you get anywhere?
Yeah. A little further than just sitting there wondering what you would like
You mentioning {{name:aiden}} has made very ordinary things feel less ordinary
What things?
He asked if I had the notes from our last class
Normally I would just send them
Today I stared at the message for a stupid amount of time before remembering he was literally asking for class notes
Please tell me you didn't send him a mysterious reply
No 😭
He got the notes. Very exciting development
Slow down, you're getting ahead of yourself
Shut up
But that's the thing. He's already part of my normal life
If we talk about this and it feels strange afterward, I'll still see him around campus
Yeah. I hadn't really thought about the next ordinary lunch together
I have
I don't think that means we shouldn't talk to him
I just don't want to treat it like asking him to join us for a game
I understand
How would you want to bring it up?
Alone, for a start
I'd rather have a slightly awkward conversation than try to explain something personal with my friends listening
And probably offering advice nobody asked for
Exactly
Wait
He's coming over. I'll text you when I get a moment
A MOMENT LATER
Is anyone sitting here?
Depends. Are you here to steal my lunch?
I was going to ask about the notes, but now that you've mentioned lunch...
You got the notes. That's your gift for today
Generous as always
You okay? You looked miles away earlier
Yeah. Just thinking about something
Something I can help with?
Maybe. I'd rather talk about it when it's quieter

steps.title: HAK//NOTICE
messages: Attention directed towards the other speaker

steps.text: Oh. Okay
Don't look so worried, it's nothing bad
I wasn't worried until you said that
Great, now I've made it sound dramatic
You can tell me when you're ready. I was only coming over to say thanks
For the notes?
For saving me from admitting I hadn't written any of that down
There he is. I was wondering why you were being so nice
I can be nice without wanting something
Then take your hand away from my fries
Fair point

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: I like knowing she's laughing, even if I'm still getting used to the thought of them together.

steps.text: 20 MINUTES LATER
Okay, I have my phone to myself again
Everything okay?
Yes. We just had a normal conversation
I nearly brought it up, but there were people sitting right next to us
He knows I want to talk about something. Not what it is
How did that feel?
Less terrifying than I expected
Although he did try to steal my lunch, so I couldn't take him too seriously
That sounds familiar
Tomorrow I'll find a quieter moment
I want to see whether we can actually talk about it before deciding anything else
Okay. Tell me how you're feeling tonight
I will
I downloaded an app during my break
You did?
Just to see what it was like. I haven't put a profile up or messaged anyone
Hang on, I'm trying to remember how to get back to the profile screen
A MOMENT LATER
Okay, found it
It was less intimidating when I stopped treating every man on the screen like some enormous life decision
Any interesting discoveries?
One man had six pictures of himself next to the same car
Maybe the car has a good personality
It certainly had more information available
Harsh
Accurate 😌
But it did help me work out something
I want to be able to talk to someone normally first
I don't want to pick a person just because we're excited about trying something new
I don't want you doing that either
And I want him to know I'm in a relationship
I don't want to get halfway through a conversation and feel like I've hidden the important part
Agreed
I'm not sure how to write that without making my profile sound like a very serious announcement
Start with hello. Probably leave out a formal introduction from your boyfriend
You mean you haven't prepared one?
I could include references
Absolutely not 😭
I'd like you to read what I write, though
Not to choose someone for me. Just because this is new and I'd rather not feel alone doing it
Of course
And when I said someone we don't know might be simpler, I didn't mean you have to trust the first person who answers
I know
Less awkward around our friends doesn't automatically mean I'll feel comfortable with him
Exactly
So tonight I'll write something and choose a normal photo
Tomorrow I can decide whether I'm happy to put it up and start a conversation
That sounds like an actual plan
A slightly nervous plan, but yes
That's allowed
I also reserve the right to complain to you about terrible profiles
That part was never in doubt
I thought the difficult part would be admitting I was curious
Now I'm thinking about how to start a conversation without sounding completely unlike myself
You don't need to suddenly become some incredibly confident person
Good, because I still rehearse phone calls before ordering food
And then tell me to call instead
Because you love me 😌
Unfortunately for my phone bill
I do want to try this
I just want the first step to feel like something I chose, not something I rushed into because we had a good conversation
Then we start there
Okay ❤️
I need to go back. They've found another reason to discuss the slides
Stay strong
I'm taking the rest of my lunch with me. It's the only thing I trust right now
